simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַקָּחָה (H4728) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מַקָּחָה (maqqâchâh) means something received , i.e. merchandise (purchased) First listed occurrence: Neh 10 32.

definitions.full: H4728. maqqachah [ מִקָּחָה ] noun feminine ware (properly thing received that is, in trade; compare לָקַח in Late Hebrew); only plural הַמִּקָּחוֺת Neh 10:32 (their) wares.
